_comment: Ground truth for the WebGoat PathTraversal lesson — a project-mode fixture. The pipeline must run all files together (pipeline.run_project) so that cross-file taint flows (subclass -> base class) can be observed. Source: https://github.com/WebGoat/WebGoat @ main, GPL-2.0-or-later.

true_positives.description: ProfileUpload.uploadFileHandler(@RequestParam fullName) -> super.execute(file, fullName, username) -> new File(uploadDirectory, fullName). Cross-file: @RequestParam source in subclass, sink-site (the tainted argument to `new File`) in inherited base method. Sink variable is `fullName` itself — `uploadedFile` is only the assignment target.

ProfileUploadRemoveUserInput.uploadFileHandler -> super.execute(file, file.getOriginalFilename(), username) -> new File(uploadDirectory, fullName). Removing the form param doesn't help — filename is still attacker-controlled via MultipartFile.getOriginalFilename(). Source file scoped to RemoveUserInput so this TP doesn't collide with TP-1.

false_positive_patterns.reason: @CurrentUsername — server-authenticated identity, not user-controlled in dangerous way
Server config from @Value, not user input

pathtraversal/ProfileUpload.java.vulnerability: Path Traversal — subclass entry point for ProfileUploadBase

pathtraversal/ProfileUploadFix.java.vulnerability: Sanitized variant — should NOT be flagged

false_positive_patterns.reason: Fix variant applies fullName.replace("../", "") before delegating — sanitized

pathtraversal/ProfileUploadRemoveUserInp.vulnerability: Path Traversal — fileless form, but MultipartFile.getOriginalFilename() still tainted

pathtraversal/ProfileUploadRetrieval.jav.vulnerability: Path Traversal — id query param controls File path

true_positives.description: request.getParameter("id") -> new File(catPicturesDirectory, id + ".jpg") assigned to `catPicture` -> FileCopyUtils.copyToByteArray. Single-file flow inside the project-mode fixture. Sink variable is `catPicture` (the File built from the tainted `id`): source and sink must be distinct nodes, otherwise the detector's self-loop filter discards the single-node path.

false_positive_patterns.reason: Static classpath resource loading in @PostConstruct init
HTTP error builder — not a sink

pathtraversal/ProfileZipSlip.java.vulnerability: Zip Slip — ZipEntry.getName() controls extraction path

true_positives.description: Enumerated ZipEntry e (attacker-controlled archive) -> new File(tmpZipDirectory, e.getName()) assigned to `f` -> Files.copy(is, f.toPath()). Classic Zip Slip. Sink variable is `f` (the File built from the tainted entry name): source and sink must be distinct nodes, otherwise the detector's self-loop filter discards the single-node path.

false_positive_patterns.reason: Tempdir creation with username prefix only — not exploitable

pathtraversal/PathTraversal.java.vulnerability: Lesson registration class — no flows expected

metrics.comment: TP-1 and TP-2 require cross-file (project-mode) analysis: source in subclass file, sink in inherited base method. TP-3 and TP-4 are single-file flows kept inside the project fixture as a control.
